description: Welcome to Cosmic Troops! We are a dynamic team based out of Erode, currently tackling the Space Mission Design Game challenge. We are passionate about gamifying space concepts and are actively looking for enthusiastic minds to join us. Our core focus spans software development, coding, and web development. To bring our game's universe to life, we are looking for teammates skilled in hardware integration, graphic design, and animation. If you speak English and want to build an epic space game.
